UPSTREAM: arch/x86: allow idt to be available to link in all stages Add Kconfig IDT_IN_EVERY_STAGE to optionally specify having the interrupt handling code available to all stages. In order to do this the idt setup is moved to a C module. The vecX entries are made global so that a table of references to all the interrupt vector entry points can be used to dynamically initialize the idt. The ramification for ramstage is that exceptions are initialized later (lib/hardwaremain.c). Not all stages initialize exceptions when this Kconfig variable is selected, but bootblock for the C, stages using assembly_entry.S, and of course ramstage do. Anything left out just needs a call to exception_init() at the right location. BUG=b:72728953 Change-Id: If1f2fde0e4b131266e89f73430b1a9b8a0218af2 Signed-off-by: Patrick Georgi <pgeorgi@google.com> Original-Commit-Id: 4b032e457f1377fc06d12214b0450eae48653565 Original-Change-Id: I4146a040e5e43bed7ccc6cb0a7dc2271f1e7b7fa Original-Signed-off-by: Aaron Durbin <adurbin@chromium.org> Original-Reviewed-on: https://review.coreboot.org/25761 Original-Tested-by: build bot (Jenkins) <no-reply@coreboot.org> Original-Reviewed-by: Furquan Shaikh <furquan@google.com> Reviewed-on: https://chromium-review.googlesource.com/1032394 Commit-Ready: Patrick Georgi <pgeorgi@chromium.org> Tested-by: Patrick Georgi <pgeorgi@chromium.org> Reviewed-by: Patrick Georgi <pgeorgi@chromium.org>

cryptohome: Add a function to get random data into a SecureBlob. Polymorphic usage of SecureBlob is problematic (see crbug.com/728047). TPM::GetRandomData takes a Blob, but many call sites were passing SecureBlobs. In preparation for making SecureBlob not inherit from brillo::Blob (which would break these call sites), add a function to get random data from the TPM directly into a SecureBlob. The need for SecureBlob in this case is questionable because the actual data from the TPM makes it back to the cryptohome code in structures that don't seem to enforce any zeroing or non-caching. However, to make this CL easier to review, just mechanically update call sites to call the appropriate function. BUG=chromium:728047 TEST=cryptohome unit tests still pass. TEST=eve boots. TEST=samus boots. cryptohome: Signature-protected sealing with TPM 1.2 Implement signature-protected sealing mechanism for TPM 1.2, which is based on the Certified Migratable Key (CMK) feature. This implementation lacks the optimization of pre-generating the migration destination RSA key in background before the unsealing operation. This will be addressed in a future CL.
